about_page_film.name: about_page_film
about_page_film.value: ("about_page"."film_url" is null) = ("about_page"."film_mime_type" is null) and ("about_page"."film_mime_type" is null or "about_page"."film_mime_type" in ('video/mp4', 'video/webm'))

about_page_film_dimensions.name: about_page_film_dimensions
about_page_film_dimensions.value: ("about_page"."film_width" is null) = ("about_page"."film_height" is null) and coalesce("about_page"."film_width" > 0 and "about_page"."film_height" > 0, true)

application_contact.name: application_contact
application_contact.value: "application"."instagram" is not null or "application"."email" is not null

application_city.name: application_city
application_city.value: "application"."city" is null or length("application"."city") between 1 and 80

background_clip_dimensions.name: background_clip_dimensions
background_clip_dimensions.value: ("background_clip"."width" is null) = ("background_clip"."height" is null) and coalesce("background_clip"."width" > 0 and "background_clip"."height" > 0, true)

media_dimensions.name: media_dimensions
media_dimensions.value: ("media"."width" is null) = ("media"."height" is null) and coalesce("media"."width" > 0 and "media"."height" > 0, true)
